nodes.title: Closed: runtime-protocol.ts and ingest list the supervisor moments (3a84688), and the runtime emits them. live_listen_started and live_listen_ended come as one pair per listener, closed before call.ended. whisper is emitted with no note, and takeover alongside its hand_off. The runtime fixture's supervisor_live call passes calls' validateRuntimeBatch (product/tests/voice-runtime-events.test.ts 4/4, and the live validator in tests/test_runtime_fixture.py)
nodes.closes_when: the contract lists the kinds and the runtime emits them, or the timeline reads the control-plane audit instead

nodes.title: Listen is a receive-only socket carrying both legs mixed (pcm16le 16 kHz) on the caller's 20 ms clock. Nothing from it is recorded or stored, and it is allowed even after a recording refusal (monitoring, not retention). Closing it never ends the call, and it takes no call slot. It is counted in health and marked by a live_listen_started/ended moment pair per listener
nodes.rationale: A supervisor must hear the call as the caller does, without being heard and without creating a retained copy. The moment pair gives the call page its listened-from/to timeline, and carries no audio and no listener id.
nodes.reverse_if: a jurisdiction treats live monitoring of a call that refused recording as needing consent, or the timeline needs the listener's identity from the runtime rather than the control plane's audit
